messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — starting a thread for any remaining security/privacy/compliance Qs (SOC2/ISO, VPC/private deploys, audit logs, KMS). Drop short Qs and we'll triage to leads.

alex: Thanks! I'll answer high-level timelines. Short version: SOC2 readiness targeted for Q3 audits, ISO cert path scoped for next FY. More detail below when needed.

sam: Re: ISO vs SOC2 — SOC2 is our immediate priority because customers keep asking for it for procurement. ISO will follow, but won't block Dedicated/Private sales.

jordan: Question: For Private (VPC) deploys, do we support customer-managed network peering or only VPN/Direct Connect today?

rachel: @jordan we support customer-managed VPC peering in the new private agent model (beta); VPN/Direct Connect are GA. Peering requires a short network security review.

jordan: Nice. Any docs/reqs we can share with sales?

rachel: Uploading checklist to the private repo after this thread — high level: CIDR, allowed ports, mutual TLS on control plane, route tables. Will link when done.

maria: KMS question from ops: do we offer customer-managed keys (CMK) for hosted inference? Is HSM-backed KMS an option?

alex: Short answer: hosted API uses provider KMS by default; we offer CMK for Dedicated and Private with HSM support for enterprise tiers. Key rotation and split-key options are on roadmap.

sam: Also note: audit logs and evidence collection are required for SOC2. We're standardizing retention & access controls now.

rachel: For audit logs: default retention is 90 days in hosted, configurable up to 365 for Dedicated/Private. For Private you can ship logs to customer SIEM. Example retention config:```audit_logs:
  enabled: true
  retention_days: 365
  export: s3://customer-audit-bucket```

jordan: How granular are the audit events? Do we capture per-request model and token counts?

rachel: We log authentication events, model selection, route, timestamps, and error traces. Token counts are recorded in usage metrics (billing) and available in console; per-request token-level logging can be enabled for Dedicated/Private for an extra cost.

maria: Compliance evidence question: will security team provide the org-level controls narrative and artifact bundles for SOC2 audits or do individual teams need to collect their own evidence?

sam: Security will own the control narrative and central evidence (access reviews, infra configs, monitoring). We will coordinate with teams to collect role-specific artifacts (runbooks, oncall rosters, training completion). We'll publish a checklist.

devops-bot: Reminder: next compliance doc drop scheduled Fri 03:00 UTC. :bell:

alex: If any customer asks about FedRAMP, we aren't pursuing it this year — it's a separate program and would be a multi-year effort. Be transparent with customers.

jordan: One more: will the rollout of CMK for hosted be backward compatible? i.e., can customers move keys without downtime?

rachel: The plan is a staged rollout with double-write for a transition window and automatic fallback. No expected downtime, but we'll require coordinated rotation. Details in the rollout doc.

maria: Cool — thanks everyone. Action items: Rachel to post VPC checklist + CMK rollout doc, Sam to publish SOC2 evidence checklist, Alex to send short customer-facing timeline note. If you have follow-ups drop them here or DM the owner. :thumbsup:
